findings.evidence: The published definition of a Morse trajectory is only for a fixed negative gradient -grad_g f. The in-flight parametrized definition imports that term, while downstream statements quantify over a general downward gradient-like field X without defining X-orbits or an identification.

The weighted Banach domain/codomain and weights are undefined; the cited dependency defines a cotangent connection rather than the tangent covariant derivatives used in D_gamma. The asserted cokernel is a quotient rather than its dual obstruction.

A null critical-value set need not be meagre, so Sard alone does not prove residuality without the omitted compact-exhaustion argument. The next lemma also upgrades finite-C^h residual sets to open dense and pulls them back to C-infinity without a valid bridge.

The theorem protects an arbitrary closed region. The opened supporting treatments require source-compatible protection conditions, including that every nontransverse orbit meets the permitted perturbation region; Audin--Damian also assumes distinct critical values. These qualifications are absent.
